bbmp_adlib (I710as): ppf_cr.cpp, sig_cr.cpp, lem_cr.cpp, mus_cr.cpp, cal_cr.cpp, vib_cr.cpp, fmt_cr.cpp (FM Tracker, I1204a), common.h and sig_cr_tables.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/adlib, commit
19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX lines, COPYING). Clean-room Ad Lib replayers written by bbmp from format descriptions. Not taken: d01_cr.cpp (EdLib D01, row I710aw). fmt_cr.cpp plays only Sagitta's FM Tracker (id "FMTRK" 1A ...); libopenmpt's Load_fmt is Davey Taylor's FM Tracker ("FMTracker\x01\x01"), a different format with the same extension. They run on AdPlug OPL (Nuked OPL3, third_party/adplug, LGPL). The helper main program bbmp-adlib.cpp is replaced by
plugins/replayers/bbmp_adlib/shim.cpp (in-process capture instead of stdout, path reads replaced by the song in memory).
misc/ (I1204b): edl_cr.cpp (EdLib Packed .edl, GPL-3.0-or-later) and its common.h (namespace misc) from bbmp csrc/misc at the same commit 19d87098 (the files are not
changed since I1204a's pin), unchanged; the engine unpacks with PKWARE implode and converts the song to a D00 file that AdPlug's d00 player plays on Nuked OPL3. misc/blast.c and
misc/blast.h are zlib 1.3.1 contrib/blast (Mark Adler), fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madler/zlib/v1.3.1/contrib/blast/ with the sha256 pins of bbmp's tools/build-misc.sh
(blast.c 1ab3e479d342bfc144167b808fb00142264bc50f24a110ca88cc774e351c218e, blast.h 9c1c422b76311d4cb06863ffc056668b6240f3dd998bc02e89ee590d482bfdc2), unchanged, under their own
zlib licence (the notice in each file header; permissive, compatible with GPL-3.0-or-later). edl_cr.cpp has its own common.h, so the files sit in a subdirectory; shim.cpp supplies
the namespace misc functions it needs (header, fail, emit, readFile, field, fromCp437) by forwarding to the adlib ones.
